name: Weapon Profile (D&D 2024)
description: One canonical SRD 5.2.1 weapon profile: Simple or Martial category, Melee or Ranged kind, permitted attack abilities, one base damage expression, and fixed source attribution. Use mechanic.dnd2024.weapon-profile.write to record or correct it. This component stores no ownership, equipment, range, properties, attack result, or damage dealt.
